Description: Armor that once belonged to a werewolf-hunting knight.
This axe may be old, but it's sharp and it's big enough to cut a Goblin in two. It'll do.

Item Name: The shoes of a Baandari trader whose travels came to an end in Bonerock Cavern.

Description: A bow given to you for breaking a curse inflicted by the hagraven Kraala.
Who knows how long this sturdy jack gathered dust in a draugr-infested tomb?

Item Name: Every shop in Orsinium has a curio that once belonged to the famous necromancer. Or so they claim.

Place: A Treasure in Need of a Home
Item Name: Presented in thanks after you recovered historical relics for the House of Orsimer Glories.

Description: The Agra Crun rewarded you with this brutal weapon for preserving Malacath's sacred words at Fharun Stronghold.

Item Name: A stout shield you won by rescuing Chief Bazrag from the prison of Fharun Stronghold.

Description: You earned this Reachfolk shoulder armor by burning the Briarheart trees of Frostbreak Fortress.

Item Name: The blade of Urfon Ice-Heart, claimed as a trophy of victory at Frostbreak Fortress.

Description: Lady Sovelle awarded you this dagger after you saved her and other survivors of the Frozen Fleet.
Good Orcish armor, made in the traditional Orcish way. No foolish Elf or Dwemer shortcuts here!
You earned this staff by helping Kireth Vanos to corral a wayward Dwarven sphere. And her brother.
The historian Sharela gave you this Yokudan jerkin for resolving a scholarly dispute over who is buried in Honor's Rest.
Awarded for helping Ashaka to find the ancient forge of Clan Morkul.

Item Name: A truly, er, unique piece. Maybe one ogre's trash is a desperate artist's treasure?
A handsome belt that would look good as part of some rough-and-ready wedding attire.

Description: You earned this ring as a reward for dealing with a relic of Malacath.

Item Name: The gloves of a Wood Elf thief make for a better trophy than King Kurog's favorite cup.
A token of gratitude from the priests you saved in Orsinium's Temple of Ire.
Chief Bazrag gave you this sturdy belt in thanks for exposing the plot against the clan chiefs at the king's Moot.
Awarded for your part in King Kurog's fall and victory over Forge-Mother Alga, the true power behind the throne.

Description: Earned by completing the Rites of Praise and Scorn in Old Orsinium. Malacath deems you worthy.
Razasha gave you this blessed cuirass for rescuing her friends from a Vosh Rakh stronghold.
A Dwemer helm found in the ruins of Rkindaleft.

Item Name: This mighty blade belonged to an Orc warrior who was lost long ago in Rkindaleft.

Description: A helm earned by avenging Chief Ogzor. If Ogzor had worn it in battle, things might have gone differently.

Item Name: Ancient Orcish gauntlets. A token of Rogzesh's gratitude for looking into Chief Ozgor's death.

Description: A piece of ancient Orcish armor Lady Laurent found in the shrines of Wrothgar's most dangerous mountain.
You helped the bookseller Nammadin after he was attacked on the road to Orsinium.
